summary.text: Brian BeGole is a Republican member of the Michigan House of Representatives from District 71 who has served since January 1, 2023, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A law enforcement officer and former Shiawassee County Sheriff, he chairs the House Government Operations Committee.

paragraphs.text: BeGole's career includes service as the Shiawassee County Sheriff.

He has chaired the Law Enforcement Officers Regional Training Commission, served on the executive board of the Michigan Sheriffs Association, and been affiliated with the Shiawassee Valley Fraternal Order of Police.

In the 2025-2026 session BeGole chairs the House Government Operations Committee and is majority vice chair of the Judiciary Committee; he also serves on the Economic Competitiveness and Energy committees.
He advanced from the August 4, 2026 Republican primary and faces Democrat Stephen Schlaack in the general election on November 3, 2026.
